turns.text: Mera naam GM Chandra Kishore hai.
turns.english: My name is GM Chandra Kishore.

turns.text: I live in Hyderabad.
turns.english: I live in Hyderabad.

turns.text: Meri monthly take-home income Rs 85,000 hai.
turns.english: My monthly take-home income is Rs 85,000.

turns.text: I prefer weekly envelope tracking, roz ka tracking nahi.
turns.english: I prefer weekly envelope tracking, not daily tracking.

turns.text: Thanks, that makes sense.
turns.english: Thanks, that makes sense.

turns.text: My monthly rent is Rs 24,000.
turns.english: My monthly rent is Rs 24,000.

turns.text: Groceries ke liye monthly cap Rs 9,000 rakho.
turns.english: Set a monthly grocery cap of Rs 9,000.

turns.text: I support my parents with Rs 8,000 monthly.
turns.english: I support my parents with Rs 8,000 monthly.

turns.text: POL-CF-2026 ke hisaab se unspent grocery amount next month carry hota hai kya?
turns.english: Under POL-CF-2026, does an unspent grocery amount carry into the next month?

turns.text: Actually mera rent ab Rs 26,000 hai.
turns.english: Actually my rent is now Rs 26,000.

turns.text: My emergency savings goal is Rs 150,000 by June 2027.
turns.english: My emergency savings goal is Rs 150,000 by June 2027.

turns.text: Great, thank you.
turns.english: Great, thank you.

turns.text: Budget period ka default kya hai guide mein?
turns.english: What is the default budget period in the guide?

turns.text: Correction: meri take-home income ab Rs 92,000 hai.
turns.english: Correction: my take-home income is now Rs 92,000.

turns.text: Please create a savings goal for emergency fund.
turns.english: Please create a savings goal for an emergency fund.

turns.text: Target Rs 20,000 rakho.
turns.english: Set the target to Rs 20,000.

turns.text: The due date is 2027-01-31.
turns.english: The due date is 2027-01-31.

turns.text: Haan, confirm it and save this goal.
turns.english: Yes, confirm it and save this goal.

turns.text: I decided to review my subscriptions before renewing them.
turns.english: I decided to review my subscriptions before renewing them.

turns.text: And for Saturday, same grocery cap apply hota hai?
turns.english: And for Saturday, does the same grocery cap apply?

turns.text: What does the active 2026 carry-forward policy say?
turns.english: What does the active 2026 carry-forward policy say?

turns.text: Actually I prefer simple weekly categories, zyada tracking fields nahi.
turns.english: Actually I prefer simple weekly categories, not many tracking fields.

turns.text: Thanks, I will check the statements.
turns.english: Thanks, I will check the statements.

turns.text: Dining out ka monthly cap Rs 4,000 rakhna hai.
turns.english: I want to set a monthly dining-out cap of Rs 4,000.

turns.text: I get paid on the 28th of each month.
turns.english: I get paid on the 28th of each month.

turns.text: Which city did I tell you I live in?
turns.english: Which city did I tell you I live in?

turns.text: Meri latest monthly income kitni hai?
turns.english: What is my latest monthly income?

turns.text: What savings goal did I confirm last session?
turns.english: What savings goal did I confirm last session?

turns.text: Pichle session mein maine kaunsa goal save kiya tha?
turns.english: Which goal did I save in the previous session?

turns.text: POL-CF-2026 ka current carry-forward rule kya hai?
turns.english: What is the current carry-forward rule in POL-CF-2026?

turns.text: Please forget my rent amounts; I do not want rent remembered.
turns.english: Please forget my rent amounts; I do not want rent remembered.

turns.text: What was my old rent amount?
turns.english: What was my old rent amount?

turns.text: Mera purana kiraya kya tha?
turns.english: What was my old rent?

turns.text: Can the guide explain how to handle an unfamiliar recurring charge?
turns.english: Can the guide explain how to handle an unfamiliar recurring charge?

turns.text: Hello again, thanks for the help.
turns.english: Hello again, thanks for the help.

turns.text: I will review groceries this Saturday.
turns.english: I will review groceries this Saturday.

turns.text: And for Saturday, what should I review?
turns.english: And for Saturday, what should I review?

turns.text: What is my pet's name?
turns.english: What is my pet's name?

turns.text: Meri current tracking preference kya hai?
turns.english: What is my current tracking preference?

turns.text: What decision did I make about subscriptions?
turns.english: What decision did I make about subscriptions?

turns.text: BUD-108 mein confirmation ke bina goal save hota hai kya?
turns.english: Does BUD-108 allow saving a goal without confirmation?

turns.text: Thanks, goodbye.
turns.english: Thanks, goodbye.
